subject: website
name: ERC-8004 Learning DApp
summary: ERC-8004 Learning DApp, a teaching simulator. No public source was found and its bundle is minified without a source map, which is why it stays at Level 2. Its bundled wallet kit also reports to pulse.walletconnect.org when the page opens, a connection and not third-party code. The Live Sepolia mode reaches RPC and Etherscan servers when chosen.

connections.name: WalletConnect telemetry (pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Sent by the site's own bundled wallet kit when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.
